title: 运行身份、健康与遥测脱敏
admission_meaning: Eligible for coordinator registration of the bounded window below; not actual START, trust, business acceptance or completed implementation.
write_notes: Paths are relative to Platform task worktree created from newly reconfirmed main. No source mutation was performed in this assessment.

New versioned namespaces and task-private tests are primary implementation; five existing observability/health files may only gain additive explicitly selected registration/adapter behavior with legacy wire retained.
Public APIs must be concrete version1 DTO/validation/observer/redaction/health registrations. No DTO-only delivery; real SDK/host integration must be exercised within existing dependencies.

No solution/project/config changes are needed for additive .cs files: existing SDK compile globs and test references suffice. If this assumption fails, return exact evidence to COORD before changing shared files.
Store task evidence under one unique WP02-25 run directory; bounded local sinks only. Task owner reports actual hashes and local observations; COORD owns state synchronization.
api_requirements: ObservabilityV1 runtime binding: declared Cp6ReleaseIdentity + environment/region + typed observed artifact kind/digest + packageSetRef/configurationDigest/schemaSetRef/deploymentRef + process-instance/epoch/start/observation time + verifier/evidence reference + Match/Mismatch/Unproven. Bounded canonical identifiers, supported versions/enums, immutable defensive copies, UTC and freshness limits; no network locator fetch. Default comparison Unproven.

Host observer must obtain evidence from the actual running process/loaded assemblies and bound byte sources, not request headers or expected declaration. Trusted expected identity is independently pinned. Metadata/source SHA and module MVID alone never prove bytes or package trust. No generic Match from two caller-filled structs; distinguish observed-by-this-adapter from independently-qualified.

HealthCheckBindingV1: component/purpose/routes/dependency/timeout/freshness/failure classification/probe policy/safe name. New registration validates required inventory, path collisions and actual check tags. Liveness constant; startup and readiness scoped to real inventory; unknown/mismatch identity prevents corresponding new capability readiness but preserves separately authorized reads. Exposes no write-permission API.

TelemetryPolicyV1: closed key/value registry, approved resource values, method/template-route/status-class/duration/safe enum only; finite record/attribute/series/cardinality/rate/queue/batch/flush bounds and drop status. Sanitize before queue/aggregation and before configured sink, including automatic spans, events, links, baggage and logs. Missing approved destination/retention/permission leaves external export disabled.

MetricDefinitionV1: preserve technical counter names and measurement points; separately define producer committed-receipt to consumer applied-receipt latency, exact unit/clock provenance/population/duplicate/retry/reset semantics and Owner references. Adapter reports observation only; no fabricated business success or invented production threshold.

Versioned safe observation envelope permanently distinguishes local fixture/non-production from qualification. Keep old ReleaseIdentity and SLO1.0.0 JSON unchanged; no global reinterpretation of /health/release200, Candidate, Evaluate Pass or ProductionSloClaimed. If shape changes, expose explicit versioned contract/profile rather than mutate legacy schema.

Concrete bounded adapter and new public registration should compile using existing Contracts/Abstractions/AspNetCore dependencies. No Release->AspNetCore dependency or reverse package-trust shortcut; host adopts Release capability lock via opaque verified references and still must supply actual runtime observation.

checks.requirement: Versioned declared/observed identity API; actual running loopback host observations of loaded modules/bytes compared with separately pinned expected manifest. Missing observer, self-report, wrong source/version/service/environment/digest/domain, duplicate or incomplete package set, stale observation and observer exception/cancellation remain Unproven/Mismatch. No fabricated expected=actual success. Safe output omits file paths and verifier exceptions. Local match cannot imply trusted package/production/independent acceptance.

Real isolated Kestrel host and actual local dependency stopped/restarted: live unaffected, required startup/ready dependency missing/wrong tag/unregistered/failed/timed-out/cancelled/stale -> never healthy. Empty required inventory fails closed for new capability. Hide sensitive entries without changing aggregate. Explicit route/read/new-effect inventory; GET performs no migration, replay, cleanup or Owner mutation; bounded probe concurrency/timeout/cache freshness.

Capture actual final trace/metric/log output of new registration, including automatic inbound/outbound instrumentation. Seed full URL/query/login code, Authorization/Cookie/body/SQL parameters, tenant/user/message/operation ids, baggage, exceptions/events/links, log templates/arguments/scopes/resource and case variants. Only approved keys AND registered finite values survive; display names and routes use templates; raw paths, high-cardinality values under safe keys and unknown resources are dropped. No claim other unconfigured log/export providers are scrubbed.

Exercise queue capacity, max record/attribute size, batching, rate/cardinality/series budget, exporter throw/block, bounded flush/dispose and repeated host lifecycle. Drop counters are safe and bounded; no waiting/retry/error crosses into request/Owner result. Overflow/missing telemetry explicitly marks incompleteness; no retrospective 100% coverage. Multi-host registration drift/global propagator replacement tested and restored.

Versioned MetricDefinition fixes name/version/unit/kind/measurementPoint/BeforeCommit|AfterCommit|ObserverOnly/attempt-vs-business scope/allowed-values/reset/aggregation/owner/source. Define producer Owner committed receipt to consumer Owner applied receipt latency with UTC/clock provenance and skew/missing/duplicate/retry rules; unavailable real receipts -> not measured, not zero. Preserve existing published/consumed/enqueue semantics, no EF/Messaging edits or fake after-commit assertions.

New observation/health/export result never grants production SLO qualification. Fixture/fault-injection/recorder evidence explicitly non-production. Candidate Pass, ProductionSloClaimed=true, source hash, valid seven-package lock or matching DI identity alone cannot set independently qualified/runtime trusted/production accepted. Existing Evaluate remains a pure legacy comparison; do not silently redefine it.

Reuse existing tests as regression test code: TelemetryConventionTests, ReleaseIdentityTests, SloEvidenceContractTests, ObservabilityRegistrationTests, OperationalEndpointTests, ObservabilityEndToEndTests and TraceContextDistributedPropagatorTests. Run affected filters once on candidate. Old run evidence cannot pass changed code without exact input equivalence.

One task-level complete diff review plus local ArchitectureTests due additive public APIs/registration boundary. Preserve dependency/project/version/schema asset constraints. Record exact source commit, dirty working-byte hashes if any, dependency hashes, commands/exit/TRX/skips/environment, module/host artifact hashes, real loopback startup/HTTP and cleanup. No new GitHub Actions, DB, published package or environment adoption claim.

risks: Runtime accessor/metadata self-consistency must not be mistaken for observing actual loaded artifact; file SHA after load is not alone proof of loaded bytes. Record the binding method and keep unsupported deployment artifact kind Unproven.
Package archive hash, loaded assembly hash, container digest, config hash and schema digest are separate domains. No new signed seven-package artifact contains these APIs yet.

Automatic instrumentation and arbitrary ILogger providers can emit data outside CP6 tags; final export capture must include events/log formatting/resource values and prove only the configured pipeline.
Allowlisting metric keys after aggregation is too late to prevent high-cardinality memory growth. Enforce bounded value vocabularies/series budgets before aggregation.
Legacy Testing recorder is unbounded, coerces decimals to double and omits events/logs from its snapshot; cannot be sole privacy/precision evidence. Leave generic repair to WP02-26.
Missing required health checks currently default to success through standard tag filtering; new guarded profile must fail closed without breaking existing hosts or silently replacing CRM ready.
Global propagators are process-wide. Same-profile DI idempotence does not prove final runtime propagator consistency across hosts; tests must clean up and avoid parallel interference.
Contracts additions may expose a new public API through existing compile globs; dependency/version/project and packaging claims cannot be changed without a coordinator window.
Original source archive is untracked under Main but pinned SHA256 matches; include byte hash evidence, do not claim it is a Git-tracked blob.
Old full test counts are historical evidence only. New runtime/telemetry changes require affected tests; no remote fetch performed, local origin refs are not a fresh online remote assertion.
